data.gender_notes: Nazif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Free from impurities, both literally and figuratively. The name Nazif carries the meaning “Pure, clean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nazif usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity of the soul and the heart
data.etymology: Nazif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazif total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نظيف
in_arabic.meaning: نظيف يعني الشخص الطاهر والنقي من كل سوء وشر
in_arabic.long_meaning: نظيف هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الطاهر والنقي من كل سوء وشر، نظيف القلب، الشخص الذي يمتلك روحًا طيبة وقلبًا سليمًا. وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مثل النظافة والطهارة، التي تعتبر من الأخلاق الحميدة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: نظیف
in_urdu.meaning: نظیف مطلب ہے صاف ستھرا، پارس صاف، بری شر سے پاک
in_urdu.long_meaning: نظیف ایک مسلم بچوں کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے صاف ستھرا، پارس صاف، بری شر سے پاک۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس میں 'نظيف' کا مطلب ہوتا ہے طاہر، نقی، اور پاکیزہ۔ اس نام کی اہمیت اس لئے بھی بڑھ جاتی ہے کیونکہ یہ پاکیزگی اور صفائی کی عکاسی کرتا ہے جو کہ اسلامی تعلیمات میں بہت اہم ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: नज़ीफ़
in_hindi.meaning: नज़ीफ़ का अर्थ है पवित्र, स्वच्छ और शुद्ध
in_hindi.long_meaning: नज़ीफ़ एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है पवित्र, स्वच्छ और शुद्ध। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है। यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जिन्हें इस्लाम में बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है, जैसे कि पवित्रता और स्वच्छता।

in_pashto.name: نظيف
in_pashto.meaning: نظيف د معنی دا لری چی پاک او صاف وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: نظيف یو ښکلی نوم دی چی د پاک او صاف معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتنو خلکو کې ډیر استعمال کیږي. دا نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د پښتو کلتور او اسلامي دود سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Nazif
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nazif is of Arabic origin, meaning 'clean, pure, chaste'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-z-f', which conveys the idea of cleanliness and purity. In Islamic tradition, the name Nazif is associated with positive qualities such as spiritual purity, moral integrity, and cleanliness of heart. The name has historical significance and is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of purity and cleanliness in Islam.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل نضيف

data.cultural_impact: The name Nazif is of Arabic origin, and it signifies a state of purity both in a physical and metaphorical sense. In Islamic culture, the concept of cleanliness and purity is highly valued, and the name Nazif can be seen as a reflection of this value. Moreover, in Islamic spiritual practices, seeking and maintaining purity of the body, mind, and soul is essential for drawing closer to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Nazif lies in its reflection of the Islamic belief in the importance of purity and cleanliness. Nazif is associated with the purification of the self, which is considered a necessary step towards attaining closeness to Allah. In the Islamic tradition, the physical act of cleaning the body, such as through wudu (ablution) and ghusl (ritual bath), is seen as a means of spiritual purification. Furthermore, striving towards moral and ethical purity is considered essential for the spiritual growth and development of an individual. Thus, the name Nazif carries a strong spiritual significance in Islamic culture, reminding us of the importance of striving towards purity of body, mind, and soul.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nazif is an Arabic name meaning "purer, cleaner" - reflecting the ongoing journey towards spiritual refinement and closeness to God. It is a reminder to continually strive for moral and ethical purity in thoughts, words, and actions.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani mentions a certain Nazif ibn al-Walid who was a companion of Imam Malik in Medina during the late 8th century. He was known for his piety and was a scholar of Hadith and Fiqh.
historical_references.context: Companion of Imam Malik in Medina, scholar of Hadith and Fiqh, known for piety

historical_references.reference: Al-Qurtubi, in his famous work 'Al-Jami' li-ahkam al-Qur'an', mentions a Nazif ibn al-Farazdaq who was a poet during the early Abbasid period in the 8th century. He was known for his refined poetry and was a contemporary of the famous poet Imru' al-Qais.
historical_references.time_period: Early Abbasid period in the 8th century
historical_references.context: Contemporary of the famous poet Imru' al-Qais, known for refined poetry
